title: fix(metadata-protocol): both publish doors judge a stored flow draft in its D2-converted spelling
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8KoK2L1RPn4y1SCPs9jqdu9)_
Fixes #29557

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:流程草稿在两道发布门(单项发布、包发布)和草稿读取的发布预判里,改为按 D2 转换后的拼写判定,与保存门一致;落库与上线的仍是草稿原始字节。
- 为什么改:早先存下的旧拼写草稿(如 get_record 的 `filters`)保存能过、引擎注册也能过,却在发布时被 422 拒掉,同一流程两道门答案不一。
- 风险与回滚:只放宽(转换后仍不合格的草稿照旧被拒,问题列表与新拼写一致);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`protocol-flow-save-replay.ts`(新共用缝 `storedFlowVerdictBody`)、`protocol.ts` 的 `promoteDraftForPublish` 判定入参、`protocol-authoring-gate.ts` 的 `draftPublishVerdict`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts -t 29557`,预期 4 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **One seam.** `protocol-flow-save-replay.ts` gains `flowVerdictBody(body, { includeRetired })`, the conversion the save door's fallback verdict applies (`applyConversionsToFlow`, the full chain minus `FLOW_FALLBACK_VERDICT_NOT_REPLAYED`), and `storedFlowVerdictBody(type, body)`, that conversion asked of a stored flow draft. The save door's fallback now calls `flowVerdictBody` instead of its inline call; no second converter exists.
- **Both publish doors.** `promoteDraftForPublish`, which the per-item publish (`publishMetaItem`) and the package publish (`publishPackageDrafts`) both promote through, hands the runtime authoring gate `storedFlowVerdictBody(singularType, draftForGate.body)`. `repo.promoteDraft` still promotes the stored draft, so the active row is the draft's bytes. The credential read and every other promotion refusal still read the stored draft.
- **The draft read's publish verdict** (`draftPublishVerdict`, the `_diagnostics` fold of #26707) judges the same converted body, so a draft read does not report a refusal its publish no longer gives.
- **Which chain.** A stored draft is a row at rest, so the publish replays the full chain, retired entries included: the chain the automation engine replays when it registers the published row (`canonicalizeFlow` defaults `includeRetired` to true for every caller but the save door) and the one `applyConversionsToStoredItem` replays on read. The save door's retired-entry predicate (`flowSaveReplaysRetired`, ruling B') is not asked again at publish: it judges authored input, and the draft's own save asked it.
- **Lint prose (comment 6587200138).** One sentence in the `validate-flow-region-shape.ts` docblock and one in its `rule-explanations.ts` entry name the runtime gate as a reader of the rule and the body it judges.
- No `packages/spec` change, no rule skipped, no carve-out in `packages/lint`.

## Why

The engine registers a stored flow in a legacy ADR-0087 D2 spelling (its canonicalizer replays the conversion), and the save door judges the converted body and stores the raw one (#21982). The two publish doors judged the raw stored draft, so such a draft saved and then failed at publish. Measured red on `origin/main` 744211fc before the fix, with the card's issues, at both doors:

<details><summary>Red, before the fix</summary>

```text
× publishes through the per-item door, and the active row is the stored bytes
× publishes through the package door, and the active row is the stored bytes
× its draft read says it publishes
Error: flow/legacy_fetch failed author-time validation: 2 issues — flows[0].nodes[1].config.filters [expression-invalid]; flows[0] [flow-region-shape-invalid]
Tests  3 failed | 40 skipped (43)
```

</details>

## Tests

New `describe('[#29557] …')` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts` (the established harness for these doors; no automation service reachable, so every save takes the fallback). The draft is the realistic one: a stored active row carries `get_record` `config.filters`, and the author's draft re-save carries the same hit, so the save replays the full chain and stores it raw.

- The per-item door publishes it; the active row carries `filters` as stored; the draft is gone.
- The package door publishes it (`publishedCount: 1`); the active row carries `filters` as stored.
- `draftPublishVerdict` answers `[]` for the stored draft, and the served `_diagnostics` carry neither `expression-invalid` nor `flow-region-shape-invalid`.
- A legacy draft that also carries a conditional edge whose CEL does not parse is refused 422 `INVALID_METADATA` at the per-item door with exactly the (rule, path, message) triples its `filter` twin gets, and the package door refuses it with the same triples and publishes nothing.

<details><summary>Ablation (fix committed first, mutated through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to HEAD blob)</summary>

```text
leg 1: protocol.ts  body: storedFlowVerdictBody(singularType, draftForGate.body)  ->  body: draftForGate.body
  × publishes through the per-item door, and the active row is the stored bytes
  × publishes through the package door, and the active row is the stored bytes
  × a draft still refused once converted is refused at both doors with the issues its canonical spelling gets
  Tests  3 failed | 1 passed | 40 skipped (44)
  ok restored: blob == HEAD (6b19396fb8a2) and git diff HEAD is empty
leg 2: protocol-authoring-gate.ts  body: storedFlowVerdictBody(singular, draft.body)  ->  body: draft.body
  × its draft read reports no publish refusal for it
  Tests  1 failed | 3 passed | 40 skipped (44)
  ok restored: blob == HEAD (fc9aabba63f1) and git diff HEAD is empty
```

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The served `_diagnostics` of a flow read (draft and active alike) still carry the read's own schema half, which parses the served body as stored: on this harness both the draft read and, after the publish, the active read answer `valid: false` with the `get_record` contract's `filters` refusal. That seam is the read's diagnostics, not the publish verdict, and it predates this change for any legacy active row; reported to the seat, not touched here.
- The restore path (`refuseRestoredBodyTheSaveDoorRefuses`) still hands the runtime gate the history body as stored. Not measured; reported to the seat.
- `protocol.ts` no longer imports `applyConversionsToFlow` or `FLOW_FALLBACK_VERDICT_NOT_REPLAYED` (both now read in the seam module; the latter is still re-exported).
- PR template headings are folded into the os-dev section order.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: Test Files 192 passed; Tests 7892 passed (VERDICT command-exit 0; on `8d76dec4`).

- After the merge, rebuilt, on `3b5f63de7`: `vitest run src/protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts src/protocol.save-flow-canonicalization.test.ts src/runtime-authoring-gate.flow-region.test.ts`: 3 files, 102 tests passed.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` on `3b5f63de7`: 61 derived; `--ran` reconciliation: 60 run, 1 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it reads every package's dist and this worktree built only the touched closure; CI runs it), 0 unrun. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` and `check:lean-entry-closure` first answered exit 3 (shallow fixture commit, unbuilt objectql) and exit 0 after `git fetch origin 621a4876` and an objectql build. `pnpm lint` exit 0.
